title: My strengths
description: Identify and highlight my qualities, talents and key achievements.

title: My values
description: Clarify what is important to me and what guides my daily decisions.

title: My aspirations
description: Clarify what I want to explore, learn or experience in the short and medium term.

title: My professional motivations
description: Understand what drives me to invest in my work and my career.

title: My areas for improvement
description: Identify the points I wish to improve or gain confidence in.

title: My interests
description: List the subjects, activities or fields I am passionate about.

title: My inspirations
description: Identify the people, projects or experiences that inspire me.

title: My obligations
description: Take into account my personal, material or family constraints.

title: My testimonials
description: Collect feedback from other people reflecting their experience of my qualities.
